integrity: The analytic theorem is proved using a standard multidimensional discrepancy inequality and an exactly established quadratic Gauss-sum bound. Finite checks provide corroboration, not certification of infinitely many cases. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The implied constant is unspecified and the power-saving exponent is not claimed optimal. Results apply to square gaps in <m,m+1> and to fixed macroscopic root windows, not to arbitrary generators or shrinking windows. Independent scientific review has not been performed.
title: Universal square-gap root profile for consecutive-generator numerical semigroups
